description: This file defines the EventsRepository class which interacts with an API to perform CRUD operations on events, such as listing, creating, updating, and deleting events within a specified date range.

classes.name: EventsRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing coroutine-based methods to interact with the events API for CRUD operations.

methods.name: listInRange
methods.description: Fetches a list of events within the specified ISO date range from the API.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new event via the API and returns the result.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing event identified by ID via the API.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an event identified by ID via the API.
